reorderPickedUp: Picked up {{label}}, position {{position}} of {{size}}. Use Up and Down to move, Enter or Space to save, Escape to cancel.
reorderSaveFailed: Could not save the order. Retry or cancel.
shortcutUnavailableHere: This command is not available in the current view.
shortcutSpeechUnavailable: Speech playback is unavailable, or this message has no readable text.
group_dm_read_failed: Could not save the group read state. Please try again.
group_dm_unread_failed: Could not mark the group message unread. Please try again.
groupFinishCurrentEdit: Finish the pending send or cancel the current edit first.
groupSendUncertain: This send has not been confirmed. Check its result before sending another message.
groupSendKeepOpen: Keep this app open: the exact encrypted request and files are retained for this session only.
groupSendSavedKeepOpen: An encrypted local copy was saved for this account and device. Restored work is never sent automatically.
groupSendRestored: An unfinished send was restored. Check its server result before starting another message.
groupSendRestoreBlocked: Pending-send restoration is not ready or a record needs attention. New sends are blocked to avoid duplicates.
groupSendRestoreFailed: Encrypted pending sends could not be read. Their records were kept; retry restoration before sending.
groupSendCryptoNotReady: Wait for this device's encryption initialization before sending.
groupSendStorageFailed: The encrypted local copy could not be saved. This attempt was not sent to the server; free storage or retry.
groupSendCleanupFailed: The server result is known, but its local recovery copy could not be removed. Check again; do not send it as a new message.
groupSendCommittedRecovery: The message completed on the server. Only local recovery bookkeeping remains; this message will not be sent again.
groupSendSourceRecoveryFailed: The message completed on the server, but its local source-file recovery chain could not be updated. Records were retained. Check again; do not send the files as a new message.
groupSendCommittedLookupPending: The previously completed message result cannot be verified right now. Its local copy was retained and nothing was resent. Check again later.
groupSendOldDevicePending: This old-device request is missing or not committed. It was not replayed; cancel it safely before making a fresh send.
groupSendPending: The server is still processing this send. Check again later; do not resend it as a new message.
groupSendDeleted: The original message was deleted. It was not sent again.
groupSendInvalidOutcome: The send result could not be verified. The original request has been retained.
groupSendContextChanged: The account, device or group access changed. This request cannot be retried in the new context.
groupSendCancelConfirm: Ask the server to cancel only if this message has not been committed. Your draft/files stay here. If it was already sent, it will not be deleted and cancellation will not be reported as successful.
groupSendCancelled: The server confirmed cancellation. Your draft/files were kept; the old request cannot send later.
groupSendAlreadyCommitted: This message was already committed. It was not cancelled or deleted; check its result.
groupSendCancelFailed: Cancellation could not be confirmed. The original request is still retained; check again before sending another message.
groupSendCancelledFiles: Files from the cancelled request are retained for review. They were not uploaded by that request.
groupUploadsPartial: Message saved. {{count}} file(s) failed. Retry sends only these files as a new encrypted message, without repeating the original text.
groupUploadsReview: Message saved, but failed file positions could not be verified. Review the files before sending again; some may already be uploaded.
groupReviewUploadSelection: Files restored to the composer. Review and remove any already uploaded files before sending.
groupReviewFilesBlocked: Finish the current edit/send or make room for up to 10 files before reviewing failed uploads.
groupTooManyFiles: You can attach up to 10 files to one message.
groupUploadOutcomeUnknown: Message saved, but its file-upload result could not be verified. Check the conversation before retrying.
groupUploadRetryFailed: Could not retry these files. They remain available for another attempt.
shortcutUnreadFailed: Could not load unread channels. Please try again.
shortcutDeviceHint: Saved on this device, active only while HiChat is focused. Use Ctrl/Alt with a key, or a function key. Message-only commands may use a bare key while the message row is focused. Reserved browser/OS combinations are rejected.
shortcutRecording: Press a shortcut; Escape cancels. Commands are disabled while recording.
shortcutError_invalid: Choose a supported combination, not just a modifier or a browser/OS reserved shortcut.
shortcutError_conflict: Another command already uses this shortcut. Change that assignment first.
shortcutError_storage: The shortcut could not be saved on this device. Your previous assignment is unchanged.
shortcutErrorVoiceConflict: This key conflicts with your current push-to-talk or global mute key.
shortcutFocusedOnly: These shortcuts work while HiChat is focused. Voice shortcuts do not run while typing. Your separate voice hotkey settings still apply.
